note: Custer County SD has no county zoning (county planning FAQ says so; Ordinance 2 covers subdivision/land use only). City of Custer zones its city limits, but publishes its zoning only as a PDF map (ZONING MAP 6-18-25) and an image (media/2796). The ArcGIS Zoning_Districts layer found on services.arcgis.com/f4rR7WnIfGBdVYFd is Fairbanks, Alaska data, not Custer. The city's ETJ web map (bhclg) contains no zoning layer. No queryable zoning polygons found.
